title: Steps to create regular term deposit

steps.text: Login to mobile application,Land on deposits dashboard
Select “Regular Term Deposit” type , Click Select
Select term deposit currency (JOD or USD)
Select 'Use the same account as funding' if needed, Click Next
After selecting the term deposit currency
Enter required deposit amount , Note: Minimum deposit amount is 5000 JOD

Select period-interest return and  Select auto renew upon maturity if needed , If selected, then select one of the below: 
 ✓ Renew principal amount only 
 ✓ Renew principal amount and credit interest , then click 'Next'
Review deposit details in JOD , Confirm the “Terms and Conditions”  then Click 'Confirm'
Enter required deposit amount , Note: Minimum deposit amount is 5000 USD

Select period-interest return and  Select auto renew upon maturity if needed , If selected, then select one of the below: 
 ✓ Renew principal amount only 
 ✓ Renew principal amount and credit interest , then click 'Next'
Review deposit details in USD , Confirm the “Terms and Conditions”  then Click 'Confirm'
